title: Cultivate Silence
coreMove: Create small pockets of active silence so attention can settle; quiet may feel uncomfortable at first because it reveals what noise helped you avoid.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who keep filling small gaps
exampleSpecs.stakes: a promised quiet hour collapsing into reflexive checking
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the produce scale to show a device-free hour exposing dependence on notifications.

exampleSpecs.audience: workers planning scarce attention before the rush
exampleSpecs.stakes: the only calm hour before campers arrive
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Plan a quiet boundary before any action happens.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers using busyness to avoid pain
exampleSpecs.stakes: silence exposing grief that chores had covered
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the garage pegboard for the chapter's only two-bad-options tension.

exampleSpecs.audience: speakers tempted to fill silence with defensiveness
exampleSpecs.stakes: answering a tense room without feeding noise
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Let two named people reveal the lesson through a brief exchange.

exampleSpecs.audience: people who expect quiet to feel pleasant
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Set an expectation that quiet will calm the session, then reveal what it actually exposes.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who answer every prompt instantly
exampleSpecs.stakes: a reply habit draining attention before teaching begins
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use a short message exchange to show a device-free boundary landing between the lines.
